mainEntity.name: How many calls to action should an AI-generated landing page have?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A page should usually have one primary action, even if it contains supporting links or secondary information. Too many equal-weight buttons can make visitors unsure whether to buy, subscribe, book, or keep reading.

Context: Run My AI Business’s funnel examples connect specific pages to specific steps, such as an opt-in page, bridge page, thank-you page, checkout, or follow-up. The page’s job should be clear within that sequence.

Key factors:
- Visitor intent and traffic source
- Stage of the funnel
- Amount of trust needed
- Whether secondary actions help or distract

Practical guidance: Ask AI to list every action on the page, rank them, and recommend one primary CTA. Use secondary links only when they answer a meaningful objection or support the main decision.

This keeps the workflow focused without requiring every page to follow the same template.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose one primary call to action that matches the page’s role. Supporting links may answer objections, but several equal-weight actions can dilute attention. Ask AI to rank all actions and remove anything that does not help the main decision.
